name: Venezuela (1863–1905)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and red, with seven white five-pointed stars arranged in a ring in the centre of the blue stripe.
history: Civil flag of the United States of Venezuela adopted in 1863 after the Federal War, with seven white stars in a ring on the blue stripe for the seven provinces that had signed the 1811 declaration of independence. The stars were rearranged into an arc in 1905.
